scientific_scope: one-shot genuinely later 2024-25 forward confirmation of the already-frozen simple exact 7+ conditional tail law q(k|T>=7); no parameter fitting, feature search, D|T or unified score matrix

score_access_contract.allowed_label: score.ft only, exactly two nonnegative integer goals
score_access_contract.selection: only the exact pre-frozen identity keys from the 16-file pool
score_access_contract.nonfrozen_match_objects_score_values: must never be decoded or materialized

estimand.prediction: the identical frozen q for every eligible tail match

statistics.oracle_external_r: diagnostic only, never used to alter predictions

all_required: coverage gate passes before scientific effect interpretation
frozen r lies inside pooled match-bootstrap 90% CI for external r_hat
frozen predicted mean excess lies inside pooled match-bootstrap 90% CI for external mean E
discrete KS Monte Carlo p-value against frozen geometric law >=0.05
frozen P(E>=1)=r lies inside pooled Wilson 90% interval
frozen P(E>=2)=r^2 lies inside pooled Wilson 90% interval
both early and late temporal blocks meet tail coverage and frozen r lies inside each block's bootstrap 90% CI
at least 5 competition-file blocks have tail n>=8
at least half of eligible competition-file blocks contain frozen r in their bootstrap 90% CI
frozen_confirmation_gate.decision: STOP_COVERAGE_FORWARD_LABELS_CONSUMED if coverage fails; CONFIRMATION_PASS only if every required gate passes; otherwise CONFIRMATION_FAIL_PARK
frozen_confirmation_gate.stopping_rule: after score values are opened, no changes to r, family, file pool, identity set, coverage minima, temporal cutoff, bootstrap seeds/confidence, KS test, thresholds or competition eligibility are permitted
